user_disabled_pair_check.name: user_disabled_pair_check
user_disabled_pair_check.value: "user"."disabled_by_user_id" is null or "user"."disabled_at" is not null

contribution_recording_provenance_check.name: contribution_recording_provenance_check
contribution_recording_provenance_check.value:
(
        ("contribution"."recording_mode" = 'legacy'
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_user_id" is null
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_person_id" is null
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_name_snapshot" is null)
        or
        ("contribution"."recording_mode" = 'self'
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_person_id" is not null
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_person_id" = "contribution"."author_person_id"
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_name_snapshot" is not null
          and length(trim("contribution"."recorded_by_name_snapshot")) between 1 and 50)
        or
        ("contribution"."recording_mode" = 'on_behalf'
          and ("contribution"."recorded_by_person_id" is null or "contribution"."recorded_by_person_id" <> "contribution"."author_person_id")
          and "contribution"."recorded_by_name_snapshot" is not null
          and length(trim("contribution"."recorded_by_name_snapshot")) between 1 and 50)
      )

family_invitation_claim_pair_check.name: family_invitation_claim_pair_check
family_invitation_claim_pair_check.value: (("family_invitation"."claim_nonce" is null) and ("family_invitation"."claim_expires_at" is null)) or (("family_invitation"."claim_nonce" is not null) and ("family_invitation"."claim_expires_at" is not null))
